get.description: Global only. Fixed trusted form and independent __Host-{product_id}_admin_login binding cookie; no default administrator. No query parameters. Cache-Control no-store.

Referrer-Policy.description: Preserve real Origin on trusted same-origin form submission; cross-origin referrer remains suppressed.

post.description: Exact configured Host and Origin, matching login binding and csrf required. Reject duplicate and unknown form fields. Persistent peer attempt limit: five attempts per fifteen minutes, 4096 peer records; two concurrent password checks per process. bcrypt password length 12-72 UTF-8 bytes. Commit independent opaque administrator session and audit before setting Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, no-Domain __Host-{product_id}_admin_session and _admin_csrf cookies. Eight hour fixed expiry; maximum 128 live sessions. No account/worker identity fallback. No password or session token in response body, URL or logs.

get.description: Current independent administrator session and CSRF cookie required. Validate persisted auth_version and expiry on every request. No management resources are implied by this identity page.

200.description: Trusted identity page with logout form
Current administrator identity; no token or password

post.description: Exact Host and Origin and form csrf matching independent current session required. Persist deletion of only that administrator session and audit before clearing admin cookies; preserve account/Edge/LAN sessions. Invalid authority fails closed; storage failure returns 503 without reporting successful central logout.

AdministratorSession.name: __Host-{product_id}_admin_session
AdministratorSession.description: Independent platform administrator session; ordinary account cookies and worker certificates do not grant platform management authority. Server also requires the matching HttpOnly admin_csrf cookie.

password.description: Implementation additionally bounds UTF-8 bytes to 12-72; no trimming or truncation.
